title: Features
intro: Turn off what your event doesn't use. A feature that is off leaves the menus, its pages and API answer "not found", and its background checks stop. Nothing is deleted: turn it back on and its data is still there.
forced: Turned off on the server ({{env}}). Change it there.

desc.incidents: The incident board for problems at seats and switches.
desc.helpdesk: Players report a problem from the QR code at their seat.
desc.dispatch: Send incidents to techs, with their own job list on the phone.
desc.handover: What the next shift needs to know, with a note from the last one.
desc.cables: Which switch port goes to which patch panel and seat, with labels for both ends.
desc.health: DHCP, DNS, the game cache and other services, from health plugins.
desc.dashboard: Tiles from plugins on one page.
desc.traffic: What the hall's traffic is made of. Turning it off also stops the NetFlow collector keeping anything.
desc.dns: What the hall looks up: top sites, categories and blocked lookups. Hall-wide only.
desc.wifi: Access point load, clients per AP and channels on the floor plan, from a Wi-Fi plugin. Client counts only.
desc.syslog: Logs from switches, firewalls and DHCP servers, kept for a day and searchable.
desc.games: What the hall plays and downloads, and what the LAN cache saved.
desc.forecast: Expected bandwidth for the next hours, with a warning before the line fills.
desc.security: Rogue DHCP, ARP spoofing, MAC flapping, loops and storms.
desc.ports: Bounce or shut a seat's switch port, with the tech's own switch login.
desc.configs: Back up the switches' running configs with the tech's own login and see what changed during the event.
desc.terminal: A terminal on one switch in the browser, with the tech's own login. Every line typed is audited.
desc.commands: Saved show commands on one or many switches, output side by side. Leads also run commands that change something.
desc.replay: Play the event back on the floor plan.
desc.timeline: Every change during the LAN on one timeline: edits, outages, incidents, alerts and deploys.
desc.report: The post-event report with its PDF.
desc.past_events: Keep each event and compare them side by side.
desc.preflight: The go or no-go board before doors open.
desc.status_page: A public page that tells attendees whether the network is fine, which areas an outage hits, and the crew's updates.
desc.public_hall: The hall map players see without signing in.
desc.stats_wall: Fun facts about the event for a big screen and attendees: data downloaded, the bandwidth peak, top games, seats online. Hall-wide only.
desc.schedule: The event programme (talks, tournaments, meals, quiet hours) with a public countdown page for big screens and phones; imports iCal.

othersIntro: Off means gone: no link, no page, no API, no background work.

cap.title: Capabilities
cap.intro: One switch for each thing the crew wants. It turns on everything that belongs to it, then says what it still needs.
cap.partly: Some parts are off: {{parts}}. Switch it on to turn them all on.
cap.forced: Turned off on the server's environment.
cap.outside: Set outside Floorbit, so it can't be checked here.

desc.front_door: The local agent answers attendees on the event network, so Floorbit sees which switch port a seat PC is on.
desc.checkin: Attendees confirm their seat with the PIN on the seat card; Floorbit links the seat to its switch port.
desc.captive_note: Phones and laptops show a quiet note until their seat has checked in. Nothing is blocked.
desc.logs: Switches and firewalls send syslog to the local agent; the lines show on the Logs page and feed the alerts.
desc.traffic: Switches and firewalls send NetFlow or IPFIX to the local agent; the Traffic page shows the totals.
desc.electrics: Power meters on the distribution boxes, on the floor plan and in the alerts.

need.cap.front_door: The front door for attendees switched on
need.dhcp114: Option 114 in the event's DHCP, pointing at the agent
need.port.syslog-relay: A UDP port for syslog on the agent
need.port.netflow-relay: A UDP port for flows on the agent
need.powerSource: A power meter plugin, such as Shelly or Home Assistant
